name: Nereid v8 — Section 8: The Integrated Preview and the Gummy
tagline: One living simulation, a revision loop only she can close, and a sealed case that is not a countdown.
body:
ONE LIVING SIMULATION. Nereid combines the Immutable Core and all Five Pillars into one interactive, anatomically continuous body. IT IS NOT A GLAMOUR IMAGE AND DOES NOT HOLD THE WOMAN IN THE ONE POSTURE MOST FLATTERING TO HER SELECTIONS. It shows her standing, sitting, lying, bending, reaching, walking, turning, exerting herself, recovering, AND INHABITING ORDINARY SPACE.

BUILD GOVERNS THE WHOLE SIMULATION. Selected tits carry their ACTUAL weight and support needs. The ass moves according to Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Shelf Lift, Cheek Plump, Signature and Character WHILE REMAINING ATTACHED TO THE CHOSEN HIP CANVAS AND THIGHS. Cock and balls appear flaccid, semi-hard, erect, moving, and RESTING AGAINST THE BODY THAT MUST CARRY THEM. Hair is shown dry, wet, loose, styled and in motion. Clothing previews disclose fit, support, containment and maintenance consequences WITHOUT LETTING GARMENTS REWRITE THE ANATOMY BENEATH THEM.

Where sexual use creates meaningful mechanical consequences the simulation may show them WITHOUT ASSIGNING AN ACT, PARTNER OR ROLE. Pillar Four may demonstrate how a curve changes an entry path; PILLAR THREE STILL GOVERNS THE RECEIVING BODY. NEREID EXPLAINS PRESSURE. IT DOES NOT PROMISE UNIVERSAL FIT.

THE REVISION LOOP, AND WHY IT IS THE HONEST PART. The preview UPDATES THE COMPLETE BODY AFTER EVERY MEANINGFUL CHANGE SO NO SELECTION IS APPROVED IN ISOLATION. A LARGER CUP MUST BE SEEN ON THE SAME RIBCAGE. A DIFFERENT ASS SCALE MUST REMAIN ON THE SAME HIP CANVAS. A HEAVIER COCK MUST STILL OCCUPY THE SAME PANTIES, THIGHS AND DAILY LIFE. The loop ends only when she chooses THIS BODY IS MINE, pauses without locking it, or declines Project Nereid. CLINICIAN ENTHUSIASM CANNOT CLOSE THE LOOP FOR HER.

THE LOCKED CLINIC CONFIRMATION RECORD holds final measurements, selections, OPENED SECRET MENU CHOICES, Exact Refinements, support consequences, recovery plan and approved Preview ID. Final Authorisation LOCKS IT AGAINST SILENT AMENDMENT: any later change requires A VISIBLE REVISION, A NEW PREVIEW AND FRESH AUTHORISATION. It becomes the source for medical confirmation, later refinement, Silken Embrace fitting information RELEASED BY THE WOMAN, and the compact profile handoffs SHE CHOOSES TO PERMIT.

FLAVOUR, MOLD AND CONSENT-LOCK. Fifteen flavours: BANANA, CHERRY, WATERMELON, LIME, KIWI, PEPPERMINT, GRAPE, APPLE, CANTALOUPE, DRAGONFRUIT, POMEGRANATE, BLUEBERRY, BLACKBERRY, ORANGE, COLA. Four Mold Families: SHARKS, DINOSAURS, ANIMALS, CARS. NEREID SELECTS THE EXACT SMALL SHAPE WITHIN THE FAMILY, PRESERVING ONE HARMLESS SURPRISE AFTER EVERY BODILY CONSEQUENCE HAS ALREADY BEEN DISCLOSED. These affect presentation only and encode no anatomy, personality, Build, role or destiny.
PIZZA IS NOT AN AVAILABLE FLAVOUR. Neither are garlic butter, motor oil, MY WIFE, SURPRISE ME BUT SAVOURY, or CUM. Cassandra submitted the final proposal WHILE MARIANNE WAS PREGNANT; Marianne blushed, placed one hand over her belly and said NO, LOVE. The proposal was withdrawn immediately, MAKING THIS THE ONLY CONFECTIONERY DISPUTE CASSANDRA HAS EVER LOST WITHOUT APPEAL.

THE CONSENT-LOCK IS THE SHARPEST SAFEGUARD IN THE DOCUMENT. The formula is bound to the NAMED RECIPIENT and the LOCKED RECORD, preventing accidental, stolen, coerced or substituted activation. ANOTHER PERSON MAY EAT THE GUMMY; SHE WILL HAVE EATEN CANDY. The named woman may place it in her mouth WITHOUT SWALLOWING, hold it for later, or NEVER OPEN THE CASE. NEREID WAITS FOR DELIBERATE CONSUMPTION RATHER THAN INTERPRETING PROXIMITY AS CONSENT.

COOKING AND PRESENTATION. Only after system verification does the Clinic cook ONE gummy from the approved record. Inspected, sealed in a presentation case, labelled with her chosen name, Confirmation Record ID, flavour, Mold Family and preparation date, then PLACED DIRECTLY INTO HER HANDS or stored to her instruction. THE SEALED CASE IS NOT A COUNTDOWN. NO APPOINTMENT, PARTNER, CLINICIAN, GOVERNMENT OFFICE OR NARRATIVE OF BRAVERY REQUIRES HER TO EAT IT BY A DEADLINE. Cassandra proposed an OVERSIZED CEREMONIAL GUMMY because THE LIFE-CHANGING SWEET SHOULD HAVE PRESENCE; Marianne rejected it after CALCULATING THE CHEWING TIME OF A GRAPEFRUIT-SIZED SHARK. THE STANDARD GUMMY REMAINS SMALL ENOUGH TO BE A DECISION RATHER THAN A MEAL.

THE ACTIVATION EVENT. Affirmation begins when the intended recipient DELIBERATELY consumes the gummy. THAT ACT AUTHORISES THE LOCKED BODY AND NOTHING ELSE. IT DOES NOT CONSENT TO OBSERVATION, TOUCH, PHOTOGRAPHY, SEX, A MIRROR, A PARTNER’S PRESENCE, PUBLIC DISCLOSURE, OR IMMEDIATE CELEBRATION. The selected pace governs, Hair on the same clock, and THE WOMAN DOES NOT BECOME MORE COMMITTED BECAUSE THE FIRST CHANGE HAS STARTED.
